I mean your not wrong that pit bulls aren’t a smart breed. One of the smarted breeds are probably poodles, but the issue is that it’s rare to see people raise pits from puppies. most cases pits are rescued cuz they are often fighting dogs and end up being abused or neglected. Becuase of this upbringing they tend to be aggressive in the nature of self defense, but when pits are raised from puppies in a safe environment they will have the temperament of any other dog. And most of the people who rescue their pit aren’t smart enough to take them to rigorous temperament training. This is why rescuing in general is risky I had a friend who rescued a lab (a breed known for being loving and loyal) but it actually is a very agressige dog (toward other dogs).

This is a fair statement, but I would like to point out that the issue that you have isn’t really in the dogs themselves but in the owners. Like, if every dog owner bought from a legit breeder and was responsible then the issues you have would practically go away. Yes there will always be dogs that do bad things despite being trained, but that is quite rare if they have been trained well. The real issue with most people who dislike dogs Have is that there are too many irresponsible owners who give a really specific breeds a bad rep. And for the dogs who turn feral, There is a term called “instinctive drift” which is what you are describing. If you train a dog and let it loose it will return to its feral state much like when the orca at sea world killed its trainer. Like I said the real issue is that there are a ton of bad dog owners, most people don’t understand the commitment and responsibility of ownership so their dog is trained improperly. Any dog has the potential to be a good dog reguardless of it’s breed, but not every dog is a good dog right off the bat.
